'''District Commander''' was a rank in use by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Bane Nothos]], an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] serving in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] tasked with disrupting the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Shantipole Project]] in the [[Roche asteroid field]], held the rank of District Commander.<ref name="SFS" />

District Commanders were in charge of districts located in [[Gralleenya]], [[Questal/Legends|Questal's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]]. They made arrangements with [[Turf Boss]]es to keep down insurgency in exchange for turning a blind [[Eye/Legends|eye]] to certain criminal activities.<ref name="GCQ">''[[The Game Chambers of Questal]]''</ref>
